item.title: Anthropic pitches AI safety bill that may block a model if 50+ people could be killed
item.description: The proposed policy seems to offer protections against AI run amok but actually forbids federal agencies from blocking a model's release without the permission of a judge.

item.title: SpaceX’s AI business is beating expectations
item.description: SpaceX hit profitably in the third-quarter, with net income of $4.4 billion. AI was the engine.

item.title: OpenAI acquires startup Orchestra Bio⁠ to beef up its biotech business
item.description: OpenAI says it's adding Orchestra's team and technology to work on Rosalind, its AI model for life sciences research, and to its related Rosalind Workbench tool, a harness that aims to help researchers plan experiments and analyze results.

item.title: Meta’s Muse hits 10M U.S. downloads in 40 days, a milestone reached by only 11 other apps
item.description: Meta's AI companion Muse has surpassed 10 million U.S. downloads in its first 40 days, joining an exclusive group of apps that includes Threads. New data also shows Muse is retaining users at higher rates than its AI rivals.

item.title: Ex-Nvidia-turned-VC Amulya Vishwanath: ‘Physical AI is in it’s LEGO era’
item.description: It’s the moment everyone is waiting for — the ChatGPT moment for robotics, Amulya Vishwanath explained to TechCrunch’s Equity.

item.title: US orders federal agencies to remove China’s DeepSeek AI from their systems
item.description: The US has ordered federal civilian agencies to remove DeepSeek products and third-party services built using its technology, citing national security concerns.

item.title: Colossal Biosciences announces new AI platform to help accelerate de-extinction efforts
item.description: Colossal announced a new AI platform to help accelerate its de-extinction efforts and Peter Diamandis has launched a new fund to back startups who use it.

item.title: SpaceXSI bundles X Premium, Grok, and Cursor into one subscription
item.description: The new X Subscription combines X's paid features with AI tools like Grok and Cursor, offering plans ranging from $8 to $200 per month.

item.title: Vesta raises $30M to bring swarms of agents to mortgage lenders
item.description: Vesta, an AI-native software startup that helps lenders originate mortgages, announced a $30 million round led by Conversion Capital.

item.title: Tony Fadell on why the first wave of AI gadgets failed — and what comes next
item.description: The “father of the iPod” says the first generation of AI gadgets failed to solve real problems — and the next wave will need to earn consumers’ trust.

item.title: Another personal AI assistant has launched — Meet Tab, which emerged from stealth with a $300M valuation
item.description: A new personal AI assistant has arrived. Meet Tab, which announced Tuesday that it had officially emerged from stealth.

item.title: Vinod Khosla believes ex-DeepMind engineer’s Wajo will win agent market on trust
item.description: Wajo's Fo agent can hire humans to complete a task.

item.title: Reddit is killing RSS feeds and ending public API access because of AI bots
item.description: Reddit is ending support for RSS feeds, as the company continues tightening access to its trove of user-generated content.

item.title: a16z-backed EliseAI raises $350M, doubles valuation to $4B
item.description: EliseAI raises $350M, doubles valuation in a year.

item.title: MAVI bets on the AI boom creating demand for a new kind of accountant
item.description: Accounting staffing company MAVI emerges from stealth with $4 million in funding.

item.title: Google Photos ‘Clueless’-inspired virtual closet is now available on Android and iOS
item.description: The AI-powered feature builds a virtual wardrobe from your photos, and is now broadly available after first rolling out to Android users in June.

item.title: YouTube doubles down on video shopping with AI-powered ‘Ask YouTube’ feature
item.description: YouTube's AI feature can now help you compare products as you shop.

item.title: Family offices are clamoring for AI investments
item.description: Whether it's a permanent shift or part of a familiar cycle is worth asking, though.

item.title: How AI could make it harder for governments to use hacking tools
item.description: AI is proving effective at finding and exploiting vulnerabilities. Some say this will make it harder for governments to use hacking tools and spyware and could reignite calls to backdoor devices.

item.title: Caterpillar is bringing to AI deployment what it learned from automating mining
item.description: Caterpillar has spent decades putting autonomous machines to work at remote mining sites. It's now bringing that experience to AI deployment.
